    lmw:[1.3,1.4,1.5,1.9,2.2,2.3,2.3,2.3],
    // left writing arm
    lax:[0,-11,-16,-20,-23,-25,-25,-25],
    lay:[0,-9,-7,-9,-10,-11,-11,-11],
    pnr:[0,-10,-13,-18,-22,-24,-24,-24],
    // right reaching arm + hand
    rax:[0,-7,-15,-17,-16,-15,-15,-14],
    ray:[0,-1,1,-4,-6,-7,-7,-7],
    // right head
    rhx:[0,-7,-6.5,-6,-5.5,-5,-5.5,-5.5],
    rhy:[0,3,3,3,2,1,.5,0],
    // right torso lean (follows the head a little)
    rtx:[0,-3,-3,-3,-2.5,-2.5,-2.5,-2.5],
    // right far hand resting on the left character's shoulder
    fhx:[0,-4,-6,-10,-10,-10,-10,-11],
    fhy:[0,-2,-3,-4,-5,-6,-6,-6],
    // left belly
    bcy:[168,167,166,164,163,162,162,162],
    bry:[36,37,38,39,40,41,41,41],
    brx:[40,40.5,41,41.5,42,42,42,42]
  };
  function v(name,t){
    var a=K[name];
    if(t>=STEP*LAST) return a[LAST];
    var i=Math.floor(t/STEP), f=(t-i*STEP)/STEP;
    return a[i]+(a[i+1]-a[i])*f;
  }
  function r(n){return Math.round(n*1000)/1000;}
  function el(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
  function eyeT(cx,cy,dx,dy,s){
    return 'translate('+r(cx+dx)+' '+r(cy+dy)+') scale('+r(s)+') translate('+(-cx)+' '+(-cy)+')';
  }
  function render(t){
    t=Number(t); if(!isFinite(t)) t=0;
    t=((t%PERIOD)+PERIOD)%PERIOD;
    var e;
    e=el('left-head-skull');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','translate('+r(v('lhx',t))+' '+r(v('lhy',t))+') rotate('+r(v('lhr',t))+' 60 110)');
    e=el('left-eye-outer');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform',eyeT(51,89,v('oex',t),v('oey',t),v('oes',t)));
    e=el('left-eye-inner');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform',eyeT(90,93,v('iex',t),v('iey',t),v('ies',t)));
    e=el('left-mouth');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','translate('+r(v('lmx',t))+' '+r(v('lmy',t))+')');
    e=el('left-mouth-line');
    if(e){
      e.setAttribute('opacity',r(v('lmo',t)));
      e.setAttribute('stroke-width',r(v('lmw',t)));
    }
    e=el('left-writing-arm');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','translate('+r(v('lax',t))+' '+r(v('lay',t))+')');
    e=el('pen');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','rotate('+r(v('pnr',t))+' 38 203)');
    e=el('right-reaching-arm');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','translate('+r(v('rax',t))+' '+r(v('ray',t))+')');
    e=el('right-head');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','translate('+r(v('rhx',t))+' '+r(v('rhy',t))+')');
    e=el('right-torso-body');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','translate('+r(v('rtx',t))+' 0)');
    e=el('right-far-hand');
    if(e) e.setAttribute('transform','translate('+r(v('fhx',t))+' '+r(v('fhy',t))+')');
    e=el('left-belly');
    if(e){
      e.setAttribute('cy',r(v('bcy',t)));
      e.setAttribute('ry',r(v('bry',t)));
      e.setAttribute('rx',r(v('brx',t)));
    }
  }
  window.nwb={render:render};
  render(0);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
